job.title: Medical Promo Review Contractor
job.description:
On Q Recruitment is partnering with a leading global pharmaceutical company to appoint a Medical Promotional Review Contractor on a 9-12 month contract.


In this role, you will play a key part in the promotional review process, ensuring marketing and educational materials are scientifically accurate, balanced, and compliant before progressing through the medical approval pathway. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will conduct detailed reviews of promotional content and supporting evidence, helping maintain the highest standards of compliance and patient-focused communication.


Key Responsibilities
  • Review promotional and marketing materials for scientific accuracy and compliance.
  • Verify claims against approved product information, clinical data, and supporting references.
  • Ensure appropriate balance between efficacy, safety, and risk information.
  • Assess the quality and relevance of referenced literature and data sources.
  • Liaise with Medical Affairs, Marketing, and Compliance teams to support timely approvals.
About You
  • Background in life sciences, pharmacy, medical communications, clinical research, or pharmaceutical industry roles.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to critically evaluate scientific and medical content.
  • Experience reviewing promotional materials or working within Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Information, or Compliance is highly regarded.
  • Medical degree not required.
This is an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to a highly respected pharmaceutical organisation while contributing to the delivery of compliant, high-quality healthcare communications.

job.title: Senior Clinical Research Associate (Contract)
job.description:

As the Sponsor representative, you will act as the lead monitor across an eight-site Phase IIa study, working closely with investigative sites and the CRO partner to provide senior-level oversight from site activation through to close-out, ensuring data quality, protocol compliance, and effective study execution. 

This role is suited to a highly autonomous CRA who is comfortable operating independently, building strong site relationships, and exercising sound judgement on study and site issues.

About You
  • Solid years' CRA monitoring experience, including Phase II studies.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP and the ANZ clinical trial landscape.
  • Able to work independently and confidently manage site issues and escalations.
  • Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy or related qualification.
  • Willingness to travel across Australia and New Zealand.
What's on Offer
  • Flexible independent contractor engagement.
  • Competitive day rate.
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior clinical leadership.
  • Exposure to an innovative respiratory development program with a growing biotech organisation.
Apply now through On Q Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Consumer Marketing Associate
job.description:
A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Consumer Marketing Associate to join a leading global healthcare organisation supporting large-scale consumer awareness and disease education initiatives across Australia and New Zealand.
  
This role is ideal for a marketing professional who enjoys campaign execution, project management, stakeholder engagement, and working in a highly regulated environment. You'll play a key role in bringing integrated marketing campaigns to life, partnering with internal stakeholders and leading creative and media agencies to deliver high-quality consumer-facing initiatives.
  

About the Role
Working closely with the Consumer Marketing team, you'll support the end-to-end delivery of consumer education and awareness campaigns across multiple channels. From agency briefing and asset development through to compliance approvals, implementation and reporting, you'll help ensure campaigns are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain exposure to large-scale omnichannel campaigns across digital, social, search, video, pharmacy, out-of-home, and traditional media channels.
  
Key Responsibilities
    • Coordinate end-to-end marketing and consumer education campaigns
    • Manage relationships with creative and media agencies
    • Develop campaign briefs and oversee asset delivery
    • Review content for quality, consistency, and compliance
    • Manage timelines, approvals, and stakeholder communications
    • Support campaign reporting, performance tracking, and marketing operations
  
About You
You are a highly organised marketing professional who thrives on managing multiple moving parts and enjoys turning strategy into execution.
  
To be successful, you'll bring:
    • Experience in marketing, campaign coordination, communications, or project management
    • Strong stakeholder and agency management skills
    • Experience working in a regulated industry (pharma, healthcare, medical devices, consumer health, financial services, etc.)
    • Exposure to digital and omnichannel marketing
    • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail
    • Proactive, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities
    • Pharmaceutical, healthcare, or consumer health marketing experience will be highly regarded
    
What's on Offer?
    • Work on large-scale consumer awareness campaigns across ANZ
    • Exposure to the full campaign lifecycle, from concept through to launch
    • Collaborate with leading agencies and cross-functional teams
    • Immediate start available
    • 12-month contract with strong extension potential

  
If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your marketing career in a fast-paced, highly visible environment and enjoy bringing campaigns to life, we'd love to hear from you.
  
Apply now or contact Jodie Jokhan for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Omnichannel Coordinator (Medical Affairs)

job.title: APS 6 - Prescribed List HTA Assessment Officer
job.description:
APS6 Assessment Officer - Medical Devices and Health Technology Assessment
Canberra ACT | 12-month contract with possible extension | $65+ per hour plus super (APS6, includes casual loading)

About the role
The Department of Health, Disability and Ageing is seeking an APS6 Assessment Officer to join the team that administers the Prescribed List of Medical Devices and Human Tissue Products. You will assess a high volume of time-sensitive applications and listings, working with clinical experts and advisory committee members.

What you will do
  • Assess Prescribed List applications and listings, from screening and analysis through to a written recommendation
  • Review existing listings and reconcile device details to identify and correct errors
  • Research clinical and health technology assessment (HTA) questions, drawing on expert advice where needed
  • Prepare reports, briefings and correspondence for applicants and committee members
  • Communicate outcomes to sponsors and manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders
What you will bring
  • Knowledge of medical devices, HTA or device reimbursement, or the ability to build it quickly
  • Ability to review and analyse technical and clinical information with attention to detail
  • Clear written and verbal communication, tailored to the audience
  • Ability to plan and prioritise your own workload in a changing environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
The details
  • Up to 38.5 hours per week
  • Start date 23 October 2026 or earlier
  • Based in Canberra, full time in the office for the first two weeks, then a minimum of three days per week
  • Australian citizenship is required
  • No security clearance required
  • A National Police Check issued within the last three months is required, at your own cost
How to apply
This role will be filled quickly, so apply as soon as possible. Apply directly to this ad with your current CV and a statement of how you meet the criteria.

job.title: APS5 & APS6 Compliance and Investigations Officers (Multiple Positions)
job.description:
About the Agency
This independent Commonwealth agency plays a critical role in maintaining public confidence in Australia's democratic processes. As significant reforms to electoral funding and disclosure legislation take effect, the organisation is expanding its regulatory capability and seeking experienced professionals to support compliance, investigations and enforcement activities.
Working within a high performing regulatory environment, you will contribute to transparency, accountability and the effective administration of electoral laws while helping shape the future of this growing function.

About the Roles
 Opportunities are available at both APS5 and APS6 levels. Depending on your experience, you may be considered for roles ranging from conducting compliance reviews and supporting investigations through to leading complex regulatory matters, providing specialist advice and mentoring team members.

Working under limited direction, you will manage complex matters, analyse information from diverse sources, conduct regulatory assessments, and deliver high quality advice to support informed decision making. You will work collaboratively with internal stakeholders, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and provide guidance to junior team members.
These positions offer the opportunity to apply your analytical, regulatory, audit, compliance or investigative expertise in a highly visible and nationally significant environment.
  
Key Responsibilities
 
APS5
  • Supports compliance reviews and investigations
  • Works under guidance
  • Developing regulatory and investigative capability
  • Focus on analysis, administration, assessment and stakeholder engagement
APS6
  • Leads complex matters
  • Exercises greater judgment and independence
  • Provides advice to senior decision-makers
  • Mentors junior staff and contributes to strategy and continuous improvement
Compliance
  • Conduct detailed reviews of financial disclosure returns to ensure legislative compliance
  • Assess election funding claims and undertake complex compliance assessments
  • Support the administration and payment of electoral funding
  • Analyse information and identify potential compliance risks or regulatory concerns
  • Prepare high quality reports, briefs and recommendations
  • Provide guidance and support to junior team members
Investigations
  • Conduct risk based investigations into potential breaches of electoral legislation
  • Gather, analyse and evaluate information from multiple sources
  • Utilise intelligence and data analysis to identify emerging risks and high risk behaviours
  • Prepare investigation reports, evidence briefs and stakeholder correspondence
  • Contribute to compliance and enforcement strategies
  • Mentor and support team capability development
About You
You are an experienced compliance, audit, investigations, regulatory, governance or assurance professional with strong analytical capabilities and sound judgment.

You will bring:
  • Experience managing complex compliance, audit or investigative activities
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Excellent written communication and stakeholder engagement abilities
  • The ability to interpret legislation, policy and complex information
  • A collaborative approach and commitment to delivering quality outcomes
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
Experience in accounting, finance, commerce, investigations, regulatory compliance or government environments will be highly regarded. 

Why Apply
  • Contribute to work that directly supports Australia's democratic system
  • Join a growing and evolving regulatory function
  • Work on complex and high profile matters with national significance
  • Access ongoing learning and professional development opportunities
  • Enjoy flexible working arrangements and strong employee benefits
  • Receive 15.4% superannuation and attractive APS conditions
This is an outstanding opportunity to apply your expertise in a purpose driven organisation where your work will have genuine public impact.
 
How to Apply?
For more information about this role, contact Rennel Richardson at rrichardson@onqrecruitment.com.au

job.title: R&D Engineer

The role has a strong focus on new product development driving prototype development from concept through to verification and supporting technology transfer into manufacturing.

Your experience within engineering will lead you to be the subject matter expert and your experience in NPD will see you planning and executing development projects, executing design verification and validation activities, and collaborating cross functionally with multiple teams including commercial, quality and regulatory teams.

Essential skillsets would be - strong technical writing; Hands on experience in biomechanical testing, computational modelling, simulation and data analysis. You will need the ability to take ownership of a defined product development program and demonstrate superior communication and organizational skills to manage external vendors and consultants. This is a high profiled role within the business, so confidence working with senior executives is critical. Experience working in GMP or ISO13485 controlled environments ideal. 

What's on Offer
An attractive salary that reflects your experience and the opportunity to take part in the company's equity plan. A clearly defined career path within a fast-paced environment. This role is based in Perth so relocation will be available for the successful candidate and potentially sponsorship for overseas applicants with medical device industry experience.

If you would like to hear more about this exciting opportunity, please call Sandy Tuckwell on 0413133255 or apply through the relevant links

job.title: Clinical Trials Manager
job.description:
On Q are proud to partner with an innovative Australian biotechnology organisation developing breakthrough therapies designed to address serious global health challenges. With an active Phase III clinical trial currently underway, we are seeking a hands-on Clinical Trials Manager to lead operational delivery across Australia and support activities in Asia-Pacific. This is a 12 Month Contract.
  
 
An exciting opportunity to join a lean, agile team where you will have direct visibility across all aspects of trial execution and the ability to make a genuine impact on study outcomes.
  
 
The Opportunity
Reporting to the Head of Clinical Operations, you will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day management of a Phase III clinical trial in Australia, including site engagement, recruitment performance, monitoring activities and vendor oversight. You will also support the coordination and oversight of local partners and sites in the Asia-Pacific region.
   
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Drive operational delivery of an active clinical trial
  • Conduct site monitoring visits and maintain strong site engagement
  • Monitor recruitment performance and implement strategies to support enrolment targets
  • Oversee local partners, CROs, vendors and service providers
  • Ensure compliance with GCP, study protocols and regulatory requirements
  • Maintain study documentation, trial management systems and inspection readiness
   
This role will suit a proactive, self-sufficient clinical professional who enjoys remaining close to sites and operational delivery rather than managing large teams.
  
 
About You
To be successful, you will bring: 
  • Solid years' experience within Clinical Research as a Senior CRA, Clinical Trials Manager, Clinical Project Manager or similar role
  • Experience supporting or managing late-stage and/or Phase III clinical trials
  • Strong site management and monitoring experience
  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP and Australian clinical trial requirements
  • Experience overseeing CROs, vendors and external partners
  • Experience within biotech, startup or emerging pharmaceutical environments is advantageous
 
What's on Offer?
  • Broad exposure across trial management, site engagement and international operations
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership
  • Hybrid working environment (3 in SYD office / 2 WFH). 12 month contract role.
  • Travel to investigator sites within Australia and periodic Asia-Pacific travel (approx. every two months, dependent on trial requirements)

If you're seeking an opportunity to join an innovative and growing biotechnology environment, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: ANZ Quality Director

Reporting into global quality leadership, the ANZ Quality Director will provide strategic oversight across multiple manufacturing sites while supporting significant transformation projects, quality system improvements, and organisational development initiatives. 
You will work closely with site leadership teams, serving as a trusted partner and advisor on quality, compliance, business performance, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities 
  • Act as the lead quality authority for Australia and New Zealand.
  • Develop and execute regional quality strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
  • Lead quality planning activities across multiple manufacturing sites
  • Provide oversight of quality operations across biologics, pharmaceutical and other regulated manufacturing activities.
  • Lead quality involvement in major site transformation and capability expansion projects.

job.title: Analytical Chemist
job.description:
Join an innovative Australian medical technology company developing breakthrough cancer surgery solutions that have the potential to improve patient outcomes worldwide. Working as part of a close-knit and highly collaborative team, you will play a key role in supporting the development, scale-up and manufacture of a novel nanoparticle-based technology currently progressing through clinical trials and towards commercialisation. 

This is a unique opportunity for an analytical chemist who enjoys variety and wants to work across analytical testing, method development, manufacturing support, quality control and product development in a fast-paced environment. 

 
About the Role

You will support analytical development and characterisation activities across research, manufacturing and quality operations.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Developing, transferring and validating analytical methods to support product development and regulatory programmes 
  • Performing analytical characterisation of polymers, magnetic nanoparticles and related materials. 
  • Conducting routine and non-routine testing to support R&D, manufacturing and batch release activities. 
  • Operating, maintaining, calibrating and qualifying laboratory instrumentation. 
  • Supporting GMP laboratory activities, SOP development and quality system compliance.  
  • Analysing data and preparing technical reports, certificates of analysis and documentation for regulatory submissions. 
  • Coordinating testing activities with external laboratories and service providers. 
  • Contributing across multiple projects as the business transitions from clinical development towards commercialisation and manufacturing scale-up. 
About You

To be considered for this role, you will have the following skills and qualifications: 
  • MSc or PhD qualifications in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry or a related discipline. 
  • Experience working within regulated laboratory environments, ideally GMP, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical device settings. 
  • Strong hands-on HPLC experience is essential. 
  • Experience in analytical method development and/or quality control.
  • Strong trouble-shooting skills. 
  • Excellent data interpretation and problem-solving skills
  • Exposure to techniques such as NMR, ICP-MS, ICP-OES will be highly regarded. 
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute across R&D, manufacturing support and quality activities. 
Why Join?
  • Be part of a company developing cutting-edge cancer surgery technology.
  • Gain exposure across R&D, analytical development, manufacturing and quality functions. 
  • Work alongside passionate scientists and engineers in a highly collaborative environment where ideas are valued and contributions have a direct impact. 
  • Join a growing organisation at a pivotal stage of product development and commercialisation. 
If you are looking for a role where you can apply your analytical expertise while contributing to the development of life-changing medical technology, we would love to hear from you. For a confidential conversation about the role, please email Grace Bitodi, gbitodi@onqrecruitment.com.au.
